intent: REFACTOR PipelineSubscriptions: inspect the implementation for layering violations (domain free of framework/DTO types), blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and duplication; refactor while keeping the public API and tests green. Unit definition: Context: event bridge between contexts (Intake -> Chronology Reconciliation -> Ledger). Implements org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle. Constructor PipelineSubscriptions(BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryContracts.TelemetrySampleValidated> validatedChannel, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryContracts.TelemetrySampleValidationFailed> failedChannel, ReconcileChronologyUseCase reconcile, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryContracts.TelemetrySampleOrdered> orderedChannel, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryContracts.TelemetryBackfillDetected> backfillChannel, AppendTelemetryRecordUseCase append). start(): idempotent; subscribes four pipelines, each with concatMap so ordering is preserved and demand is bounded: validated -> reconcile(sample, VALID); failed -> reconcile(sample, VALIDATION_FAILED); ordered -> append.appendOrdered; backfill -> append.appendBackfill. A per-event error is logged and swallowed (onErrorResume) so one bad event never cancels a subscription. stop(): idempotent; non-blocking: runs reconcile.flush() then disposes all subscriptions once flush completes. isRunning() reflects the started state. Subscriptions are owned and disposed here (no leaks).
